# 76. Minimum Window Substring

[LeetCode](https://leetcode.com/problems/minimum-window-substring/) · **Hard** · Pattern: [Sliding Window](README.md) · [All patterns](../README.md) · [Home](../../README.md)

> **Key insight:** Expand right until the window covers t (missing == 0), then shrink left while it still does.

## Approach

1. Expand right until the window covers t (missing == 0), then shrink left while it still does.
2. Complexity: time `O(|s| + |t|)`, space `O(alphabet)`.

| | Complexity |
|---|---|
| Time | `O(|s| + |t|)` |
| Space | `O(alphabet)` |

## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0076-minimum-window-substring.py</code></summary>

```python
from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    def minWindow(self, s: str, t: str) -> str:
        need = Counter(t)
        missing = len(t)
        best = (0, float("inf"))
        left = 0
        for right, c in enumerate(s):
            if need[c] > 0:
                missing -= 1
            need[c] -= 1
            while missing == 0:
                if right - left < best[1] - best[0]:
                    best = (left, right)
                need[s[left]] += 1
                if need[s[left]] > 0:
                    missing += 1
                left += 1
        return "" if best[1] == float("inf") else s[best[0]:best[1] + 1]
```

</details>
<!-- prep:solutions:end -->
